items_flat.title_en: xAI Releases Grok 4.6: Frontier Intelligence for Long-Running Agents at Same Price as 4.5
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok 4.6：以與 4.5 相同價格提供長程代理的前沿智能
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Grok 4.6 on August 12 as a significant improvement over Grok 4.5, focused on long-running agents, interactive and visual work, and complex multi-step tasks. It matches GPT-5.6 Sol on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (score 61) while remaining at $2/$6 per million tokens. The model is available today in the API, Cursor, Grok Build and partners, with 2× included usage for the first week.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 於 8 月 12 日宣布 Grok 4.6，相較 Grok 4.5 有顯著提升，專注長程代理、互動與視覺工作及複雜多步驟任務。它在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上與 GPT-5.6 Sol 並列（得分 61），價格維持每百萬 token $2/$6。模型今日已於 API、Cursor、Grok Build 及合作夥伴上線，首週提供雙倍用量。
items_flat.analysis_en: This keeps xAI competitive on the price-performance frontier while targeting the agentic workloads that drive real productivity. Independent long-horizon evaluations versus closed models will determine whether the claimed gains in sustained multi-step reliability hold up outside controlled benchmarks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉讓 xAI 在性價比前沿保持競爭力，同時瞄準真正驅動生產力的代理工作負載。相對於封閉模型的獨立長程評估，將決定其在持續多步驟可靠性上的宣稱能否在受控基準之外成立。
items_flat.quote: It delivers frontier intelligence and is a significant improvement over Grok 4.5 at the same price.
items_flat.quote_zh: 它提供前沿智能，並在相同價格下對 Grok 4.5 有顯著改進。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind Launches SL2T: Sign-Language-to-Text Model Powers ASL Input on Pixel 11
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 SL2T：手語轉文字模型為 Pixel 11 提供 ASL 輸入
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced SL2T, a massively multilingual sign-language-to-text model trained on more than 100,000 hours of data across 50+ sign languages. Starting today it powers American Sign Language-to-English dictation in Gboard and Live Transcribe on Pixel 11, using on-device pose tracking for privacy. The model achieves a zero-shot 70 BLEURT score on the FLEURS-ASL benchmark.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 SL2T，這是一個大規模多語手語轉文字模型，訓練數據超過 10 萬小時、涵蓋 50 多種手語。即日起在 Pixel 11 的 Gboard 與 Live Transcribe 提供美式手語轉英文聽寫，並採用裝置端姿態追蹤以保護隱私。該模型在 FLEURS-ASL 基準上達到零樣本 70 BLEURT 分數。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moves sign-language AI from research demos into everyday consumer devices for the first time. Scalability to more languages and devices, plus real-world accuracy on complex signing and one-handed use, remain the key uncertainties for broader impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 首次將手語 AI 從研究演示推進到日常消費裝置。能否擴展到更多語言與裝置，以及在複雜手語與單手使用情境的真實準確度，仍是影響更廣泛採用的關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing a massively multilingual sign-language-to-text (SL2T) translation model that marks a breakthrough in quality and generality.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出大規模多語手語轉文字（SL2T）翻譯模型，在品質與通用性上取得突破。

links.label: Google DeepMind Blog – Putting sign language AI into users’ hands

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Models Now Available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak 網路安全模型現已於 Amazon Bedrock 提供
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made its Daybreak Blue (GPT-5.6 Sol with defensive safeguards) and Daybreak Red (purpose-trained GPT-5.6 Cyber) models available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock. The models support authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation and security testing inside existing AWS environments under Daybreak Access controls.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Daybreak Blue（具備防禦性安全防護的 GPT-5.6 Sol）與 Daybreak Red（專為網路安全訓練的 GPT-5.6 Cyber）模型開放給符合資格的客戶，於 Amazon Bedrock 使用。這些模型在 Daybreak Access 控管下，支援授權弱點研究、漏洞驗證與安全測試，並可在現有 AWS 環境中運行。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extends frontier cyber capabilities into the cloud platforms enterprises already trust, potentially accelerating defender adoption while keeping strict access controls. Real-world uptake and the balance between capability and misuse risk will determine long-term impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿網路安全能力延伸至企業已信任的雲端平台，可能加速防禦方採用，同時維持嚴格存取控管。實際採用率以及能力與濫用風險之間的平衡，將決定長期影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing the next step in our work with AWS: making Daybreak capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們與 AWS 合作的下一步是：透過 Amazon Bedrock 提供 Daybreak 能力。

links.label: OpenAI Blog – Daybreak models are now available on AWS

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Report: Enterprise AI Shifts from Assistance to Agentic Execution
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 報告：企業 AI 從輔助轉向代理執行
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published data showing enterprise usage is becoming more agentic: Codex accounted for 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers as of June. Frontier firms now generate 8.3× more tokens per user than typical firms, up from 2.6× in January, and advanced capabilities such as Plugins see higher adoption at the frontier.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布數據顯示企業使用正變得更代理化：截至 6 月，Codex 佔企業客戶 Codex 與 ChatGPT 合計輸出 token 的 64%。前沿企業現在每位使用者產生的 token 量是一般企業的 8.3 倍（1 月時為 2.6 倍），且 Plugins 等進階能力在前沿企業的採用率更高。
items_flat.analysis_en: Provides rare quantitative evidence of the agent transition inside real companies. The widening frontier-firm gap suggests early movers are compounding advantages that later adopters may find hard to close.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 提供罕見的量化證據，顯示真實企業內部正發生代理轉型。前沿企業差距持續擴大，暗示早期採用者正在累積後進者難以追趕的優勢。
items_flat.quote: Enterprise use is becoming more agentic. As of June, Codex generated 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 企業使用正變得更代理化。截至 6 月，Codex 佔企業客戶 Codex 與 ChatGPT 合計輸出 token 的 64%。

links.label: OpenAI Blog – From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Turns Claude in Chrome Side Panel into Full Claude Cowork Session
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Claude Chrome 側邊欄升級為完整 Claude Cowork 會話
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that the Claude in Chrome side panel is now a full Claude Cowork session. Conversations are saved to history, skills and connectors work in the browser, and tasks started in a tab can continue on desktop, web or mobile apps. It is available immediately on Max and Team plans, with Pro rolling out in coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude in Chrome 側邊欄現已成為完整的 Claude Cowork 會話。對話會儲存至歷史記錄，技能與連接器可在瀏覽器中運作，且從分頁開始的任務可在桌面、網頁或行動應用程式繼續。Max 與 Team 方案即日起可用，Pro 將於未來數週推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Closes a practical workflow gap by making browser-based multi-step work persistent across devices. Adoption will depend on how reliably Claude acts inside real websites and how enterprises manage the residual prompt-injection risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過讓瀏覽器內的多步驟工作可跨裝置持續，彌補了實用工作流程缺口。採用程度將取決於 Claude 在真實網站上的行動可靠性，以及企業如何管理殘餘的提示注入風險。
items_flat.quote: The Claude in Chrome side panel is now a Claude Cowork session. Conversations are saved to your history, your skills and connectors work in the browser, and a task you start in a tab can be finished on the Claude desktop, web, and mobile apps.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude in Chrome 側邊欄現在是 Claude Cowork 會話。對話會儲存至歷史，技能與連接器可在瀏覽器運作，從分頁開始的任務可在 Claude 桌面、網頁與行動應用完成。

links.label: Anthropic / Claude Blog – Claude Cowork comes to the Chrome side panel

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Releases Open Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: Efficient 30B MoE for Agentic Workloads
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 發布開源 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning：高效 30B MoE 代理工作負載模型
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA launched Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (3B active) optimized for high-volume specialized tasks in always-on multi-agent systems. It claims up to 4× faster output speed and is fully open with weights, data and recipes for post-training customization via NeMo.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 推出 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，這是一個 300 億參數的混合專家模型（活躍參數 30 億），針對永遠在線的多代理系統中高流量專門任務優化。它宣稱輸出速度最高可達 4 倍，並完全開源權重、數據與配方，可透過 NeMo 進行後訓練客製化。
items_flat.analysis_en: Reinforces the open-weights efficiency trend for on-device and edge agents. Post-training flexibility and real-world agent harness performance will determine whether it becomes a default building block for specialized agent fleets.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 強化開源權重在裝置端與邊緣代理的效率趨勢。後訓練彈性與真實代理框架表現，將決定它是否成為專門代理艦隊的預設構件。
items_flat.quote: Today, NVIDIA is expanding its Nemotron 3 model family with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, the highest-efficiency model in its class for long-running agentic AI workloads.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，NVIDIA 擴展 Nemotron 3 模型家族，推出 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，這是該類別中針對長程代理 AI 工作負載效率最高的模型。

links.label: NVIDIA Blog – Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard
